netsourcecasting.page.intro.text:
Spell costs no longer have to come out of your own mana — they can be paid from the Source stored in a storage network.

Carry any AE2 wireless terminal bound to an ME Wireless Access Point, or join a Beyond Dimensions network and select it as your primary one. Spell costs are then paid from those networks first, and only what they cannot cover falls back to your own mana.

At least one of the two routes has to be installed. With neither, this mod stays out of the way and casting behaves exactly like vanilla Ars Nouveau.
netsourcecasting.page.me_network.text:
Requires Applied Energistics 2 and Ars Énergistique together, with Source stored in the network.

1. Pair an AE2 wireless terminal in an ME Wireless Access Point.
2. Put an ME Source Storage Component or ME Source Jar into the network.
3. Cast — the network pays. Binding once is enough; you do not have to stay near the access point.

If the network holds no Source, nothing is drawn from it and the whole cost falls back to your own mana.
Requires Beyond Dimensions.

1. Create a dimension network and select it as your primary one in the Primary Network Switcher.
2. Feed Source into it through an Interdimensional Source Pathway.
3. Cast — that network pays. No ME network and no AE2 involved.

Only your primary network counts: if you belong to none, or have not selected one, this route stays out.
netsourcecasting.page.config.text:
config/netsourcecasting-common.toml

payment.network_pays_full_cost (default true)
  true  — when the networks hold enough Source, casting consumes none of your own mana;
  false — your mana is spent as usual and the networks cover only what you cannot pay.

sources.me_first (default true)
  true  — spend the ME network's Source first, the dimension network only once it runs short;
  false — the other way round.
  No effect without Beyond Dimensions installed.
